scripts.ios:check-xcode-version: sh -c 'XC_VERSION=$(xcodebuild -version | grep Xcode | awk "{print \$2}"); if [ $(echo $XC_VERSION | awk "{print int(\$1)}") -lt 16 ]; then echo "⚠️ Xcode ≥ 16 is required for Expo SDK 53. You have $XC_VERSION. You can bypass this check by running \"pnpm ios:run\" but you may encounter native build errors."; exit 1; fi'
